svg.title: ICBC 1974 registry emblem — unhatched construction linework
svg.desc: Approximate manually rebuilt boundaries of CIPO drawing 0374886. The semicircle faces left, as in the source. The upper component is rebuilt as paired curved regions, not chevrons. Colour hatching is omitted. Outline-only presentation intentionally does not infer the original colours or filled regions. This is research geometry, not an official master.
